ReviewResult

VERDICT: FAIL

Findings:

- BLOCKER — `framework/templates/app-scaffold/src/app/admin/readiness/page.tsx.tmpl:135` / `:136` and `:179` / `:180` vs `framework/templates/app-scaffold/src/app/admin/readiness/actions.ts.tmpl:46` / `:54`: the rendered forms submit `id` and `checked`, but the server action requires `ownerClass` and `nextChecked`. Every UI toggle returns `ok:false` at `actions.ts.tmpl:47-51` before `patchChecklistItem()` is reached. The owner-action writeback flow does not work end to end.

- BLOCKER — `framework/templates/app-scaffold/src/app/admin/readiness/page.tsx.tmpl:139-153` and `:181-196`: clicking the visible checkbox does not submit the server-action form. There is no client handler, no `onChange`, and the only submit button is `sr-only`. Even if the field names matched, the founder’s normal “toggle checkbox” flow would not persist to `FOUNDERS_CHECKLIST.md`.

- HIGH — `framework/templates/app-scaffold/src/lib/readiness/group.ts.tmpl:80-83` and `framework/templates/app-scaffold/src/app/admin/readiness/page.tsx.tmpl:345-354`: open `sprint-work` / `waiver` items are grouped into `in-sprint`, then rendered with `OpenItemRow`, which includes a checkbox writeback form. That creates a visible toggle for non-owner-action items with no valid backing checklist line. This fails the “non-owner-action item cannot be toggled” edge case and the traceability requirement against orphan toggles.

- HIGH — `framework/templates/app-scaffold/src/app/admin/guides/[ref]/page.tsx.tmpl:58-68`: `resolveGuideRef()` strips path separators before validation, so a traversal-shaped ref whose basename is allowlisted, such as `../../DEV_SETUP_GUIDE.md`, resolves to `DEV_SETUP_GUIDE` instead of 404ing. It is constrained to `_content`, so this is not arbitrary disk read, but it does not satisfy the claimed invalid/path-traversal deep-link behavior.

- MEDIUM — `scripts/scaffold/founders-checklist.js:262` / `:278-288`, `scripts/scaffold/readiness-report.js:182`, and `framework/templates/app-scaffold/src/lib/readiness/group.ts.tmpl:22-35`: empty or missing checklist errors are produced, but `toReadinessView()` drops `checklist_errors`, and the page renders only “0 of 0 done” plus cold-start copy. The empty-checklist edge case is not surfaced to the founder as an actionable error.

Positive traceability checked: producer `source` is dropped by `toReadinessView()` at `group.ts.tmpl:26-35`, and report-level `schema` / `product_id` are not copied into the view. That part holds, but the toggle/writeback path is broken, so the binding verdict is FAIL.
